eventMetadata.context_description: Texas Longhorns' quarterback Quinn Ewers remains sidelined with an abdominal strain per the official injury report, elevating freshman Arch Manning to starter in a tough road test at BYU's raucous LaVell Edwards Stadium, where the Cougars boast a perfect 4-0 home mark this season. BYU's 6-1 recent form, fueled by junior QB Jake Retzlaff's efficient play and a top-15 defense allowing just 16.3 points per game, contrasts Texas' road struggles (2-1 away, prone to turnovers). Traders price BYU's edge from superior Big 12 matchup dynamics, rest advantage off bye, and historical success against SEC foes, reflecting crowd wisdom amid Longhorns' depth concerns at skill positions.
